ai_summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. experienced a significant 28% sequential drop in Q2 FY27 Net Profit, primarily due to lower 'Other Income' and a substantial 18.9% increase in total expenses, particularly employee benefits which surged 32.8% year-over-year. This escalation in operational costs is a material concern, leading to an 8.4% year-over-year decline in quarterly net profit despite modest revenue growth, and presents a red flag for future profitability.
